featured.title: Moonlit sky polarization patterns from Cerro Paranal
featured.authors: B. Pereira, S. González-Gaitán, A. M. Mourão, J. Rino-Silvestre, A. Paulino-Afonso, J. P. Anderson, A. Cikota, A. Morales-Garoffolo
featured.summary: We measured how the full-Moon sky over ESO Paranal is polarised, in four colours, with FORS2 at the Very Large Telescope, and compared it with single- and multiple-scattering models. Polarisation peaks 90° from the Moon and drops from about 60% in blue light to 30% in near-infrared light.
